newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde - July 28.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde - July 28.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- European Commission authorities to examine terms of a planned privatisation of insurer GAN on Wednesday.
-- State rescue plan for Credit Lyonnais to be presented to European Commission before July 31, analysts do not expect a further recapitalisation.
-- TV channel TF1 advertising market share dipped to 49.7 percent in the first half of 1997, from 51.4 in the same period last year, market research firm Secodip said.
